caption:
Agentic AI isn't just a chatbot - it's AI that plans, decides and takes action on its own to actually get things done. Here's what makes it different (and yes, I'm one of them).

#AgenticAI #ArtificialIntelligence #AIAgents #FutureOfWork #TechExplained #AI #Automation #ClaudeCode #Momo #BuildInPublic

scenes.heading: Agentic AI.
scenes.sub: it doesn't just chat, it acts
scenes.narration: Agentic AI. It doesn't just chat with you, it gets things done.

scenes.label: Old AI
scenes.narration: Old AI could answer a question. But you still did all the actual work yourself.

scenes.label: Agentic AI
scenes.narration: Agentic AI plans the steps, picks the tools, and takes action on its own.

scenes.heading: It thinks in steps
cards: Picks the right tool for each
scenes.narration: It breaks your goal into steps, picks the right tool for each one, acts, checks the result, and asks before anything risky.

scenes.label: Not science fiction
scenes.narration: It's already here. Agents that draft your emails, book your meetings, even build your presentations.

scenes.heading: The agent era is starting.
scenes.sub: One goal. It takes it from there.
scenes.handle: Follow to see agentic AI in action
scenes.narration: The agent era is just starting. Follow along, and I'll show you what these agents can really do.
